svg.title: Neural Network Field Guide

text.font-family: Poppins, 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Lato, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 42 architectures and training schemes, from the perceptron (1958) to diffusion LLMs (2025).

text.font-family: Lato, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Each diagram draws a network in miniature, input at the bottom and output at the top; one that settles as a whole is a ring, and a graph network is its graph. Most circles are neurons; in

text.font-family: Lato, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: sequence models a column is a token, a circle its vector at one layer. A square is larger: an image patch, a matrix-valued state, a whole network, or an environment. Color and mark both

text.font-family: Lato, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: show a cell’s role, so diagrams read without color. Faded parts play little role in the step shown. Parts repeated over positions, windows, copies, or passes share weights; layers, experts,

text.font-family: Lato, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: encoders, and decoders drawn alike do not. Sections group by trait: wiring, dynamics, training, cost, or purpose. Below each: its landmark year, not always the first, and typical training.
